actions.rationale: Ownership asymmetry is in the priced CA hiking cycle, not in USDCAD. Size $40m of the $100m gross cap so unknown CRA open interest and analog hike-continuation risk are not a full-allocation bet; remaining $60m stays undeployed versus the cap. Do not match carry 75m or dove 85m.

events.invalidation: BoC delivers the priced 2027 hiking cycle or Canada core leaves the near-2% zone.
events.rationale: Fade the crowded energy-hawk / BoC-must-hike book by shorting 2027 implied CORRA (receiving Canada 2027). Verified: CRA prices +84bp by Mar-27 and +130.5bp by Dec-27 from 2.29 while Canada labor is 38 and core is near 2%; CAD specs have already covered to a 99th-percentile 1y net; the desk thesis says energy blocks easing even where growth is softer. Inference: that narrative is owned, so the better asymmetry is against further CA-rate upside, not with it. Unknown: CRA open interest and CME positioning, so this is not a claim the futures pit is empty. Explicitly not the trade: long AUDCAD at a 5y extreme, long JPY after a 99th-percentile leveraged-fund pile-in, or joining residual US duration shorts.
